wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/approvals..name: Signed approvals
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/approvals..description: Accepts a protected action only with a signed human decision tied to that exact request; expired, reused or unsigned ones are refused.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/gate_decla.name: Gate on/off switches
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/gate_decla.description: Reads the human switches for the unreliable-test and pipeline checks exactly as committed at the start of the run.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/gates.py.name: Human approval gates
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/gates.py.description: Pauses before irreversible actions until a human decides, and sorts changed files into sensitive categories.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/guardrails.name: Safety floor
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/guardrails.description: Checks every change a worker made against the allowed scope, refuses to judge unreadable folders, and keeps run state out of commits.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/hooks/__in.name: Live protection files
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/hooks/__in.description: Package for the protection files that the safety installer sets up during a run.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/hooks/pret.name: Live file guard
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/hooks/pret.description: Before Claude touches a file, blocks it if it is outside the run's allowed area; blocks when unsure.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/path_safet.name: Safe paths
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/path_safet.description: Rejects names and paths that try to escape their folder, including through shortcuts.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/protected_.name: Sensitive file rules
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/protected_.description: Recognises sensitive or irreversible files, such as passwords or deploy settings, and decides whether a human must approve changes.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/severity_f.name: Minimum severity rule
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/severity_f.description: Raises certain kinds of finding to at least major by fixed rule, not by a critic's opinion.

wilfred/tools/wilfred-signer.py.name: Approval signing tool
wilfred/tools/wilfred-signer.py.description: The tool the human uses to create a signing key and sign approvals, so protected steps cannot be approved by the system itself.
